nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and $k > 0$ an even natural number, and let $G^k_p$ be the directed graph on $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ with an edge $a \to a^k$ from every vertex $a$. Its (weak) components are the classes of the equivalence relation "$a^{k^m} = b^{k^n}$ for some natural numbers $m, n$". Then $G^k_p$ has exactly two components if and only if every prime factor of $p - 1$ divides $k$.
